Reach us.

We forge a kinetic cultural space to supercharge the restless spirit. Believing in the primal, transformative power of tribal electronic rhythm, we use our performance art, sound, and movement to ritualize the communal experience. Our goal is to reconnect mind and body, channeling raw energy into collective liberation and dancing humanity into a fierce, imaginative future.
